what_this_is: The CLI inputs each release gate script requires, as the release-process
standard enumerates them. The standard is maintained outside this repository,
so this file is the repository-side copy that the machine check can read.
What the check proves: every required input a script declares is also
enumerated here. What it does NOT prove: that this file still matches the
standard. A required input added to a script goes red here until it is listed
here too; whether the standard was updated in the same breath is a review
question, and the check cannot answer it -- it has no copy of the standard.
Adding a required input is a change to the release process's input surface.
Update this file in the same commit, and the standard in the same round.
